project_type: Next.js 16 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Zod 4, React Hook Form 7, Sonner toasts, no test framework
build_system: Next.js (npm scripts). No monorepo. `next build` does a full compile + type-check. Tailwind 4 via PostCSS — all tokens are CSS custom properties in src/app/globals.css.
test_framework: None — the project has zero test files. Verification means `npm run build` and `npm run lint` both pass.
verification_instructions: 1. cd /Users/raheelarfeen/Programming-Hero_lvl_2/Assignment_6+7/RaktoSheba-Frontend  2. npm run build  3. npm run lint  Both must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors or ESLint warnings.
environment_constraints: No dev server restarts needed. Do not push to remote. Commit locally after each FEAT with `git add -p` or specific files, then `git commit -m 'feat: ...'`.
contribution_requirements: Follow the existing code style exactly — no new dependencies, no new utility libraries. Match token/class names seen in existing components (bg-cream, rounded-[24px], etc.).
key_patterns: 1. Server Components are `async function Page()`, call `(await getSession())!`, fetch data inline. 2. Client components start with `"use client"`, use `useTransition` + `startTransition` for Server Actions. 3. Server Actions live in `src/app/actions/*.ts` with `"use server"` at top, call `getSession()`, role-check with `redirect()`, call `api(...)`, call `revalidatePath(...)`, return `{ ok: true } | { error: string }`. 4. Multi-step wizards use `useForm` + `zodResolver`, `trigger(stepFields[step])` before advancing, a progress bar of `h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full` spans, and a `Step X of N` counter. 5. Loading files: always `loading.tsx`, export default `Loading()`, use skeleton components from `src/components/ui/skeleton.tsx`. 6. Toast: `toast.error(result.error)` on action failure, `toast.success('...')` on success. 7. Confirm dialogs: use `src/components/ui/confirm-dialog.tsx` — mount only while open, pass `onConfirm`/`onClose`/`pending`. 8. API layer: `src/lib/api.ts` exports `api<T>(path, options)` and `apiPaginated<T>(path, options)`. Authenticated calls pass `{ token, cache: 'no-store' }`. 9. File uploads: bypass the JSON helper with raw `fetch` to `${API_URL}/...` with `authorization` header, same pattern as `uploadDonorPhoto` in `src/app/actions/donor.ts`.
directory_structure: src/app/dashboard/hospital/ — hospital workspace pages (currently only page.tsx + loading.tsx). src/app/actions/ — server actions (donor.ts, auth.ts, payments.ts). src/lib/ — API helpers and pure utilities. src/types/index.ts — all backend types. src/components/ui/ — shared UI primitives. src/components/request/ — request board components (filters, card, status-timeline). src/components/dashboard/ — dashboard shell + nav config.
